items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I was with Fletcher Henderson and you know Bea. She's white as anybody - Fletcher's first wife.

ctx.x: No, but I'm talking about 20 or 30 years ago.

That's what I'm talking about. I was with Fletcher Henderson and you know Bea. She's white as anybody - Fletcher's first wife. We played theatres there, Fletcher Henderson's band, and if we wanted a sandwich we'd have to go around to the back... She'd go right in front and get it.
